title: Qualify shared and distinct right-root projections on JBMC
description: Check whether JBMC can distinguish the same skipped write by the right root specifically. On the 71 nullable/shared heaps the witnessed right-root change must alias the left root and reproduce on the JVM. On the nine distinct non-null pairs of zero- or one-cell binary arrays, both implementations must preserve the right root, including equal-but-distinct arrays. Recheck the original two-root preserving and distinguishing pair on that distinct profile. Record the checked bounds, nullability, alias group, guard, selected observations, raw checker bytes and proof non-vacuity.
expected: Four complete non-vacuous establishments and two independently replayed refutations. The wide right-only witness names a shared root. The nine-heap both-root profile uses the same semantic and subject digests as its earlier handler refusal.
